title: Match the Distribution, Not the Compute: Post-Training Multi-Token Prediction Heads
abstract: arXiv:2610.00888v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) improves the throughput of autoregressive generation by enabling the language model to draft multiple next tokens per forward pass, while a verification step over draft tokens ensures that token distribution of the backbone is preserved. Every open MTP-family release (MiMo-7B, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3) trains its heads jointly with the backbone over the full pretraining run of tens of trillions of tokens, thus setting the drafter quality at pretraining time. translated_title: 匹配分布而非算力：后训练多Token预测头
translated_abstract: 多Token预测（MTP）通过使语言模型能够在每次前向传播中起草多个下一个Token来提升自回归生成的吞吐量，同时通过验证步骤确保骨干模型的Token分布得以保持。所有开源的MTP系列模型（MiMo-7B、DeepSeek-V3、Qwen3）都在长达数万亿Token的完整预训练过程中与骨干模型联合训练其预测头，从而在预训练阶段就固定了起草器的质量。我们提出这样一个问题：在一个冻结的推理模型上，仅对目标生成的思维链进行轻量级的后训练，是否足以达到相同的预期吞吐量加速，并研究了如何优化基于这种检查点构建的推理服务系统。我们提出了三个发现。1）在冻结的Qwen3-8B上使用K=3的链式MTP头，我们证明了在约25亿个Token上使用普通交叉熵的后训练方案即可达到或超过（通过全量预训练联合训练）的预期加速。
tldr: 该研究发现，在冻结的推理模型上，仅用约25亿Token的普通交叉熵后训练即可训练多Token预测头，达到与数万亿Token全量预训练联合训练相当的吞吐量加速效果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that a lightweight post-training pass with plain cross-entropy on ~2.5B tokens suffices to train multi-token prediction heads on a frozen reasoning model, matching or exceeding the throughput speedup of heads trained jointly over the full multi-trillion-token pretraining run.
